whyItMatters: php log calls output credential-named values ((?:echo|error_log|print_r)s*(?[^;]*(?:password|passwd|secret), which persist in log stores.
actions: Remove the value from the log call; emit presence flags or redacted markers.
Rotate any credential already written to logs.
Re-run the scan and confirm no credential-named value remains in log calls.
verification: Rescan shows no credential-named value in log calls, and log samples hold no secrets.
